thesis: Work Receipts is the foundation because all other ventures depend on proving what happened
argument: Without receipts, you cannot build reputation. Without reputation, you cannot route. Without routing, you cannot have RealityRouter. Therefore Work Receipts must come first.
evidence: SCITT IETF draft for agent action receipts (Aug 15, 2026)
ERC-8004 attempts but lacks grounded receipts
test: Build receipt SDK and measure adoption by existing marketplaces

thesis: Proof schemas are the immediate wedge because they can be used today
argument: Every marketplace needs to know what proof to collect. Defining proof schemas is a registry problem, not a marketplace problem. Low competition, high utility.
evidence: Truepic validates willingness to pay for visual verification
MeatLayer includes proof uploads but no standard schemas
No existing proof schema registry for agent tasks
test: Create proof schema registry and get 3 marketplaces to adopt

thesis: The five ventures are converging into one architecture
argument: SCITT, AP2, FIDO, ERC-8004, EAS are all moving toward the same architecture: PRINCIPAL → MANDATE → AGENT → WORK → EVIDENCE → ATTESTATION → RECEIPT → REPUTATION. Build the receipt layer and you own the data moat.
evidence: FIDO working on proof of user intent
SCITT being applied to agent action receipts
EAS explicitly markets toward AI agents
test: Map all standards to the architecture and identify gaps

thesis: Reputation should be computed from grounded receipts, not ratings
argument: ERC-8004 analysis found reputation was a poor trust signal. Ratings lack grounding. Receipts provide verifiable evidence. This is the key differentiator.
evidence: ERC-8004 empirical study found Sybil/coordinated behavior
Feedback frequently lacked grounding in verifiable interactions
test: Build reputation system from receipts and compare to ratings

thesis: The deepest moat is the accumulated observation history
argument: A competitor can implement your JSON format. They cannot recreate three years of verified economic history. Every receipt makes the dataset more valuable.
evidence: API Evangelist published 11,511 YAML artifacts but lacks history
Historical observation is the moat in LLM Deals
Task × executor × outcome × evidence quality × price × latency is extraordinary dataset
test: Start accumulating receipt data from day one

thesis: Agent Resource Intelligence is the coherent category: volatile, fragmented, commercially important information that agents need normalized.
SameModel API has highest novelty (10/10) because no one measures real provider differences systematically.
AI Credits API has highest feasibility because credit programs are publicly documented.
AgentDeals (LLMDeals expanded) is the fastest path to market because architecture already exists.
